name: unsafe fn drop (slot : & mut ManuallyDrop < T >)
rule: If `T` is not `Copy`, using the contained value after `ManuallyDrop::drop(slot)` can cause undefined behavior; assigning a new value over it counts as a use because that drops the old value again.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::mem::manually_drop::ManuallyDrop < T > { unsafe fn drop (slot : & mut core::mem::manually_drop::ManuallyDrop < T >) }
